2610.10957.title: TRACE: A Governance Framework for Measuring Explainability Debt in Production AI Systems
2610.10957.paper_summary: Production AI systems deployed in high-stakes domains accumulate a governance liability that existing monitoring frameworks fail to detect: the progressive inability to explain individual decisions when regulators, auditors, or affected individuals demand accountability. We introduce TRACE (Transparency, Risk, Accountability, Compliance, and Explainability), a seven-instrument governance framework for measuring, tracking, and remediating Explainability Debt in production AI systems. The foundational instrument, the Explainability Debt Score (EDS), quantifies the proportion of production decisions falling below a governance-defined explainability confidence threshold at any point in time. Complementary instruments include DART (Debt Accumulation Rate Tracker for breach forecasting), SHIV (Scenario Health and Integrity Validator for daily governance), FDE (Feature Drift Evaluator for causal attribution), HVE (Human Validation Engine), AIDE (Audit Intervention Decision Engine), and ZERO (Zero Explainability Risk Optimiser for remediation). Through a twelve-month longitudinal case study of a production fraud detection system processing 50,000 daily financial transactions, achieving 98.46% accuracy and ROC-AUC of 0.9990, we demonstrate that an EDS of 0.23 on audit day was statistically predictable six months in advance using DART trajectory analysis (beta = 0.008/week, R-squared = 0.94, 95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]), and that 78% of Explainability Debt was concentrated in the highest-regulatory-risk decision category (transactions above $10,000), a risk asymmetry completely invisible to system-level metrics. TRACE provides the first quantitative operational architecture for EU AI Act Article 13 compliance in production AI deployment, establishing a new subdiscipline of explanation governance distinct from explanation generation.
2610.10957.paper_summary_zh: 生產 AI 系統在高風險領域的部署積累了一種治理負債，現有的監控框架無法檢測到：當監管機構、審計師或受影響的個體要求問責時，逐漸無法解釋個別決策。我們介紹 TRACE（透明度、風險、問責、合規性和可解釋性），這是一個七項工具的治理框架，用於衡量、跟踪和修復生產 AI 系統中的可解釋性負債。基礎工具，即可解釋性負債分數（EDS），量化在任何時刻低於治理定義的可解釋性信心閾值的生產決策所佔的比例。補充工具包括 DART（違規預測的負債累積率跟踪器）、SHIV（每日治理的情境健康和完整性驗證器）、FDE（因果歸因的特徵漂移評估器）、HVE（人類驗證引擎）、AIDE（審計干預決策引擎）和 ZERO（零可解釋性風險優化器）。通過對一個處理每日 50,000 筆金融交易的生產欺詐檢測系統進行為期十二個月的縱向案例研究，該系統達到了 98.46% 的準確率和 0.9990 的 ROC-AUC，我們展示了在審計日的 EDS 為 0.23 是可以通過 DART 軌跡分析在六個月前進行統計預測的（beta = 0.008/週，R-squared = 0.94，95% CI: [0.006, 0.010]），並且 78% 的可解釋性負債集中在最高監管風險決策類別（交易金額超過 $10,000），這種風險不對稱在系統層級的指標中完全不可見。TRACE 為生產 AI 部署中的 EU AI Act 第 13 條合規性提供了首個定量運營架構，建立了一個與解釋生成不同的解釋治理新子學科。
2610.10957.author: Harish Kant Pathak et.al.
